item.title: Visual Studio adds resumable, unsaved Markdown investigation notes
item.description: Microsoft: Visual Studio 2026 version 18.11 can create standalone Markdown notes, and the opt-in Hot Exit preview can restore unsaved notes after Visual Studio is closed and reopened. This helps developers resume investigations without having to save the note or add it to a project first.

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows weekly update highlights hardening and safer credential handling
item.description: GitHub: GitHub Agentic Workflows’ October 26 weekly update recaps six hardening releases, emphasizing stronger static analysis, safer credential handling, and clearer diagnostics. Highlighted changes include network credentials for safe-output integration jobs and secret-safe error diagnostics for engine-driver crashes.
